title: Residual-augmented flow matching operators for probabilistic partial differential equations
abstract: arXiv:2512.12749v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Learning surrogate models for physical systems with latent uncertainty remains challenging in data-scarce regimes: deterministic neural operators fail to characterize uncertainty, while generative approaches require large ensembles of high-fidelity solution operator simulations and often sacrifice resolution generalizability. In this work, we propose a residual-augmented probabilistic operator learning framework that casts flow-matching-based generative modeling in infinite-dimensional function spaces while leveraging inexpensive low-fidelity solution operators as an inductive bias. Rather than learning the full high-fidelity stochastic solution operator directly, the proposed framework learns probabilistic residual operators that characterize the discrepancy between low- and high-fidelity solutions. translated_title: 用于概率偏微分方程的残差增强流匹配算子
translated_abstract: arXiv:2512.12749v3 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：在数据稀缺的场景下，为具有潜在不确定性的物理系统学习代理模型仍然充满挑战：确定性神经算子无法刻画不确定性，而生成式方法则需要大量高保真解算子模拟的样本集合，且往往会牺牲分辨率上的泛化能力。在本工作中，我们提出了一种残差增强的概率算子学习框架，该框架将基于流匹配的生成建模置于无限维函数空间中，同时利用廉价的低保真解算子作为归纳偏置。与直接学习完整的高保真随机解算子不同，所提出的框架学习刻画低保真解与高保真解之间差异的概率残差算子。通过使用以已知系统输入和低保真解为条件的神经算子对流匹配中的向量场进行参数化，该框架能够在数据稀缺条件下实现高效且具备不确定性量化的偏微分方程代理建模。
tldr: 提出了一种残差增强的概率算子学习框架，在无限维函数空间中利用流匹配生成建模并借助廉价低保真解算子作为归纳偏置，通过学习刻画低保真与高保真解之间差异的概率残差算子，在数据稀缺条件下实现对偏微分方程系统的高效不确定性量化代理建模。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a residual-augmented probabilistic operator learning framework that employs flow matching in infinite-dimensional function spaces with inexpensive low-fidelity solution operators as inductive bias, learning probabilistic residual operators between low- and high-fidelity solutions to achieve efficient uncertainty-quantified surrogate modeling of PDEs in data-scarce regimes.
